proof_body:
by
  intro R _ x y z n
  rw [add_assoc, add_pow]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [add_pow, Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
  ring
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommSemiring R] (x y z : R) (n : ℕ), (x + y + z) ^ n = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n - i + 1), (n.choose i : R) * ((n - i).choose j : R) * x ^ i * y ^ j * z ^ (n - i - j)
